caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mantel clock with a rectangular base and an arched top. The clock is vertically oriented and features two main circular sections stacked one above the other. The upper section displays a clock face with black Roman numerals marking the hours and two black hands indicating the time. The background of the clock face is a light, off-white color with a slightly aged or weathered appearance. The lower circular section of the clock contains an emblematic design that includes a dark blue background, a central circular motif with a light border, and surrounding decorative elements featuring two human figures, an eagle at the top, and additional ornamental flourishes. The clock’s case is rendered in rich brown tones with fine wood grain texture and is accented by vertical gold-colored columns on either side. The overall composition is centered within a lightly colored rectangular border, and a faint signature appears at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Mantel Clock or Shelf Clock
